description: Manage cards, phases, comments and database records using Pipefy GraphQL.

pipefy_card_changed_trigger.description: Runs each time a card changes in Pipefy. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

pipefy_new_card_trigger.description: Runs for each new card in Pipefy. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

pipefy_new_table_record_trigger.description: Runs for each new table record in Pipefy. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

pipefy_table_record_changed_trigger.description: Runs each time a table record changes in Pipefy. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
